name: tau2-harnesses
description: Higher-order harnesses (Claude Code plugins) for the tau2-bench customer-service domains. Each plugin governs a domain's determinism spectrum: soft judgment as skills, arithmetic as scripts, hard invariants as deterministic hooks, over the existing tau2 MCP tool connectors.

plugins.name: retail-harness
plugins.description: Domain-specific harness for the tau2-bench retail domain: per-procedure skills, a deterministic price-delta script, a pre-write guardrail hook, a policy-auditor sub-agent, and the retail MCP tool connector.

plugins.name: legal-harness
plugins.description: Domain-specific harness for the tau2-bench legal domain (NSW boutique-firm client intake under the LPUL): per-step intake skills, a deterministic costs-disclosure / fee calculator, a pre-write guardrail hook for the fee and disclosure-threshold rules, an intake-auditor sub-agent, and the legal MCP tool connector.
